metadata.purpose: Compare checkpoints before owned child fine-tuning; adult status recorded per speaker

evidence.previous_user: User previously identified these as their own voice, contrasting it with child speech.
evidence.speaker1: No age in source metadata; user confirmation requested.
evidence.speaker2: No age in source metadata; user confirmation requested.

metadata.window_condition: Same 2.5s PCM windows, 0.5s hop, zero onset offset; single-clip replay
metadata.metric: Full equality of canonical phonetic sequences; same-sound spelling differences accepted
metadata.execution_note: An initial full inference run was repeated after an aggregation-only JSON serialization error; counts here describe the completed repeat.
metadata.scope: No owned child fine-tuning for any checkpoint; primary adult scores exclude age-unconfirmed speakers
limitations: Adult confirmation is conversation-based, not independent age documentation
Tiny owned recording sample; not general adult accuracy or post-child-finetuning performance
Models already have different upstream training data/objectives; this does not equalize all training history
Reference labels are intended/supplied words, not expert actual-phone annotations
Exact phonetic matches are raw recognition, not product pass/retry decisions
No real wa-only negative recordings tested; few jak-a controls cannot establish a stable false-acceptance rate
No new thresholds, training, ONNX export, or Unity deployment
